nodes.label: Hybrid Transport Model
nodes.rationale: SmartIDS uses WebSockets for event streams, WebSocket+polling for dashboard aggregates, on-demand fetch for details, server-rendered fetch for initial page data, and polling for engine command intake -- not a polling-only or WebSocket-only app.

nodes.label: Duplicated useDashboardRealtime Subscriptions Issue
nodes.rationale: Each of ServiceStatusStrip, OverviewMetricsGrid, and OverviewCharts calls useDashboardRealtime() independently on /overview, opening multiple WebSocket subscriptions and duplicate 30s polling loops for the same dashboard aggregate; fix is to lift the hook to a shared provider/page-level parent.

nodes.label: RealtimeStatusBadge Separate Socket Issue
nodes.rationale: RealtimeStatusBadge opens its own socket only to show connection status instead of reusing shared realtime connection state; wasteful but not broken.

nodes.label: Pages Labeled Live But Not Truly Live Issue
nodes.rationale: traffic and health pages are server-rendered snapshots only and logs fetches once on mount; if realtime behavior is expected these should be connected to socket channels or polling, otherwise labeled as snapshots.
nodes.norm_label: pages labeled live but not truly live issue

nodes.label: Dashboard WebSocket Partial Push Update Issue
nodes.rationale: useDashboardRealtime accepts dashboard_metrics pushes but only updates summary fields and derived series; timeline, distribution, and model metrics still depend on the polling path, so the dashboard is not fully push-complete.
nodes.norm_label: dashboard websocket partial push update issue

nodes.label: Backend-First Fetch with DB Fallback Pattern
nodes.rationale: Initial page state pages (threats, sessions, blocked-ips) fetch from the backend first and fall back to local DB only if that fails, keeping a single predictable data path.
nodes.norm_label: backend-first fetch with db fallback pattern

nodes.label: Canonical Legacy CICIDS2017 Training Implementation Plan
nodes.norm_label: canonical legacy cicids2017 training implementation plan

nodes.label: Loader Specialization for Canonical Feature Schema
nodes.rationale: Specialize CICIDS2017Loader at the dataset boundary: map CICIDS2017 headers, validate all canonical fields, and select exactly FEATURE_COLUMNS, so the legacy training command inherits the canonical live-compatible contract without duplicating feature logic.
nodes.norm_label: loader specialization for canonical feature schema

nodes.label: Reproducible Dataset Preparation CLI Pattern
nodes.rationale: A focused CLI loads sorted source CSVs, calls the shared strict feature validator, normalizes labels, performs a seeded stratified split, and writes outputs plus hashes and distributions so train/test datasets and provenance metadata are validated and reproducible.

nodes.label: Staged CICIDS2017 Model Build Implementation Plan
nodes.norm_label: staged cicids2017 model build implementation plan

nodes.label: Staged Build with Atomic Activation and Rollback
nodes.rationale: Build orchestrator validates prepared dataset metadata, trains and evaluates inside a same-filesystem staging directory, verifies artifacts through the runtime loader, writes manifest and sample contracts, then swaps the staged directory into place with rollback, to build/verify/activate a live-compatible model bundle atomically with one command.
nodes.norm_label: staged build with atomic activation and rollback

nodes.label: Strict CICIDS2017 Dataset Validation Implementation Plan
nodes.norm_label: strict cicids2017 dataset validation implementation plan

nodes.label: Strict Canonical Dataset Validation Pattern
nodes.rationale: A focused validator maps raw headers, validates canonical fields and finite numeric values, and returns exactly FEATURE_COLUMNS, so schema drift and invalid canonical feature values are rejected consistently during both training and evaluation instead of being zero-filled.

nodes.label: Frontend Data Sources and Docker Postgres Plan
nodes.norm_label: frontend data sources and docker postgres plan

nodes.label: Docker Postgres Pinned Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: Keep all DB reads/writes pointed at the Docker Postgres container (localhost:8080 in dev) so the frontend and backend share the same source of truth instead of drifting to a local standalone database.
nodes.norm_label: docker postgres pinned source of truth

nodes.label: Single Predictable Frontend Data Path
nodes.rationale: Keep public pages static, protected dashboard pages behind the login gate, and route browser-side backend reads through same-origin frontend API proxies, using backend-first fetch with local DB fallback only where intended, so there is one predictable data path.

nodes.label: Strict CICIDS2017 Dataset Validation Design
nodes.rationale: Use one strict validation path for live-compatible CICIDS2017 training/eval so schema drift or invalid numeric values cannot be hidden by zero-filling; dataset repair or regeneration must stay explicit rather than silently patched.

nodes.label: Dashboard Analytics Persistence Design
nodes.rationale: Persist dashboard analytics snapshots backend-side instead of relying on transient client-side/realtime state, so charts survive reload and degraded websocket periods render honestly (empty states) instead of fabricating history.

nodes.label: Dashboard Analytics Data Rules
nodes.rationale: No browser-facing page should write directly to Postgres; persistence stays backend-owned and additive/non-destructive; empty or missing analytics data should render as empty states rather than errors.

nodes.label: Safe-Change Rule
nodes.rationale: A friend already completed part of the frontend; avoid broad rewrites, route renames, or schema churn, and layer new work behind small, reviewable changes that preserve working behavior.

nodes.label: Honest-Fallback / No-Fabrication Theme
nodes.rationale: A sustained series of 2026-07-01 changes progressively replaces fabricated or derived dashboard fallback values (threat trends, session totals, queue usage, block timelines) with real backend-persisted or backend-polled data so charts stay honest during degraded periods.

nodes.label: Security UI And Copy Rules
nodes.rationale: Use accurate IDS terms (detected/blocked/watchlisted/blocked for future traffic) and never claim perfect inline prevention, since SmartIDS is a passive IDS with reactive mitigation, not an inline blocker.

nodes.rationale: Keep changes additive, preserve the existing dashboard shell/route map, keep backend field names to avoid mapping drift, and update CHECKLIST.md before/after each chunk; UI language must avoid inline-prevention claims since SmartIDS is a passive IDS with reactive mitigation.

nodes.label: DB Fallbacks Mask Broken Backend Integration
nodes.rationale: Direct DB/mock fallbacks on major live pages are useful during migration but currently hide backend auth/contract failures (e.g. silent 401s), so a page can look populated even when protected backend REST calls are failing.

nodes.norm_label: hybrid capture + processing architecture implementation plan

nodes.label: IDS Queue Throughput Scaling Implementation Plan
nodes.norm_label: ids queue throughput scaling implementation plan

nodes.label: Hybrid Capture/Processing Architecture Pattern
nodes.rationale: Splits SmartIDS into a capture process (minimal parse + IPC enqueue) and a processing process (session ownership, ML prediction, response policy) so packet ingestion stays responsive when ML/session work spikes; keeps session-state ownership in a single process to avoid cross-process flow-state corruption; keeps backend forwarding, alert publishing, and telemetry off the hot path via background threads; framed as a safer incremental upgrade than fully multiprocessing all packet workers.

nodes.label: IDS Queue Throughput Scaling Strategy
nodes.rationale: Improves the current single-consumer packet queue path incrementally (configurable queue sizing, overload telemetry, throttling of expensive prediction work under backlog) before considering more invasive multi-consumer or multiprocessing changes; explicitly rejects simply increasing Queue(maxsize) alone since that only delays pressure rather than fixing throughput.

nodes.label: Throttle Active-Session ML Under Sustained Backlog
nodes.norm_label: throttle active-session ml under sustained backlog

nodes.label: Overload Load-Shedding Policy
nodes.rationale: Degrades work in strict order under queue pressure: never drop inside the sniff callback before parse+enqueue; preserve session accounting and finalized predictions; skip repeat active-session ML first; skip optional verbose logs next; keep backend publishers asynchronous and bounded.

nodes.label: CICIDS2017 Dataset Preparation Command
nodes.rationale: Converts verified raw CICIDS2017 CSVs into strict canonical train/test datasets without modifying source files; validates all input files before writing any outputs so failures leave the output directory unchanged; splits stratified by normalized label; records source/output hashes, row counts, feature order, label distributions in metadata for provenance.

nodes.label: ml.training.build_cicids2017_model command
nodes.rationale: Validates prepared datasets, trains the live-compatible model, evaluates it, verifies runtime loading and prediction via load_runtime_model_artifacts, writes complete handoff artifacts, and activates them only after every check passes; builds in a staging directory and only promotes it after full verification so failed builds never modify active artifacts.

nodes.label: Staging + Atomic Activation Pattern
nodes.rationale: Builds artifacts in a temporary sibling staging directory on the same filesystem as the active model directory, copying existing active files in first so unrelated artifacts remain intact; after training, evaluation, manifest creation, runtime validation, and sample prediction all pass, renames active to backup then renames staging into place; restores the backup if activation fails, so failed builds never modify active artifacts.
